deps: env -u RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN rustup component add clippy rustfmt && env -u RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN cargo install --locked cargo-deny

hooks.lint: env -u RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN cargo clippy -q --all-targets -- -D warnings -W clippy::pedantic -W clippy::unwrap_used -W clippy::expect_used -W clippy::dbg_macro -W clippy::todo -W clippy::unimplemented
check: env -u RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN cargo clippy -q --all-targets -- -D warnings -W clippy::pedantic -W clippy::unwrap_used -W clippy::expect_used -W clippy::dbg_macro -W clippy::todo -W clippy::unimplemented
